description.title: Welcome to the Land of the Seven Sisters
description.content: Northeast India is a realm of enchantment, where the first rays of the sun kiss the snowy peaks of the Himalayas and the mighty Brahmaputra river weaves tales of ancient civilizations. A tapestry of eight distinct states, this region is a sanctuary of biodiversity, vibrant cultures, and untouched natural beauty. From the cloud-shrouded hills of Meghalaya to the dawn-lit mountains of Arunachal, every corner whispers stories of myths, legends, and a harmony between man and nature found nowhere else.

glance.description: A biodiversity hotspot featuring 8 distinctive states, over 200 tribes, and landscapes ranging from the Himalayan peaks to tropical rainforests.

gateway.title: Journey to the Unexplored
gateway.description: Embark on an adventure through the eight states, each a unique jewel in India's crown. Whether you seek spiritual solace, high-altitude trekking, or a deep dive into tribal heritage, the Northeast awaits.

paragraphs: Northeast India is where the Himalayas meet the monsoons, creating landscapes that seem painted by nature herself.
For centuries, these mountains and valleys have been home to communities who understood that life and land are inseparable.
Isolation became a gift—preserving languages, crafts, and wisdom that the modern world has only begun to discover.
Today, the Northeast stands as a testament to what happens when people choose to live with nature rather than against it.

peopleSection.title: People of the Hills and Valleys
peopleSection.description: The Northeast is home to communities where the individual exists within the collective—where oral traditions carry history, where festivals mark seasons, and where every person knows the name of their land.

definingThemes.title: Ancient Landscapes
definingThemes.description: From snow-capped peaks to living root bridges, hills and valleys that have shaped life for millennia.

definingThemes.title: Cultural Mosaic
definingThemes.description: Over 200 tribes, each with distinct languages, beliefs, and traditions woven into daily life.

definingThemes.title: Borderland Identity
definingThemes.description: A region where ancient trade routes meet, creating unique exchanges and resilient communities.

definingThemes.title: Living Biodiversity
definingThemes.description: One of the world's biodiversity hotspots, where communities have preserved nature for generations.

culturalThreads.title: Festival Rhythms
culturalThreads.insight: From Hornbill to Bihu, festivals here are not celebrations but the heartbeat of communities

culturalThreads.title: Music as Memory
culturalThreads.insight: Every song carries a story, every dance a prayer—music is how history travels through time

culturalThreads.title: Woven Stories
culturalThreads.insight: In the patterns of shawls and fabrics, you can read the identity of entire communities

culturalThreads.title: Wild Sanctuaries
culturalThreads.insight: Home to rare species and vast forests, nature here is not just a resource but a living deity

contributions.title: A Living Laboratory
contributions.description: Home to the world's wettest place, ancient forests, and species found nowhere else on Earth.

contributions.title: Indigenous Wisdom
contributions.description: Sustainable farming, natural medicine, and conservation practices refined over generations.

contributions.title: Organic Heritage
contributions.description: From Assam tea to Manipur's black rice, agriculture here is traditionally organic and biodiverse.

contributions.title: Handloom Legacy
contributions.description: Each state's weavers create textiles that are wearable art, recognized globally for their craftsmanship.
